phases.seal: full ledger committed before either OOS slice

calendar.purpose: Independent session membership only; daily vendor open remains fill reference. No market prices acquired from this package.

diagnostics: ex-top-5 positive strategy-return sessions, same benchmark dates

diagnostic_conventions.calendar_year: Compound the corresponding daily equity returns within each parent ledger; label partial years.
diagnostic_conventions.pre_post: Compound the corresponding daily returns of each parent ledger; retain parent holdings, no retrospective retune.
diagnostic_conventions.ex_top5: Set the five largest positive strategy daily returns and identical benchmark-date returns to zero; preserve elapsed time; diagnostic only; ties by earliest date.

account.equality: retain; GLD or cash fallback when uninitialized
account.terminal: pre-scheduled final close liquidation with cost
account.dividend: prior-close holdings entitlement; payment-date close cash; next-open reinvestment; terminal receivables at face value

metrics.cagr: (final_net_equity/initial_equity) ** (365.2425/elapsed_calendar_days)-1; first scored date to last scored date
metrics.max_drawdown: positive magnitude; daily equity peak includes initial capital and terminal costs
metrics.sharpe: sqrt(252)*daily_mean/sample_std, zero RF; zero variance NA
metrics.turnover: sum absolute traded notional / equity immediately before respective trade batch
metrics.switches: changes of selected core target, excludes initial and terminal scheduled trades
metrics.completed_round_trips: position episodes closed to zero, including terminal; partial rebalance sells are not completed episodes
metrics.exposure: mean fraction of marked equity by asset/cash/receivable before terminal liquidation; session-count denominator

criteria.H_approx: CAGR >= .30 and DD <= paired QQQ; explicitly approximate diagnostic
criteria.R: CAGR >= QQQ CAGR-.02 AND DD <= QQQ DD-.05; W-local and W-full both required for robust
criteria.persistence: R inequalities separately on the two OOS slices
criteria.bounds: Uniform PASS/FAIL across all 8 W-full TR variants is evaluable with disclosure; flip/uncomputable corner NOT EVALUABLE
